review_notes: Independently re-verified every source/sink/root_cause/fine_trace file:line:code against the vulnerable source in n132/arvo:12419-vul. All match exactly: SAX2.c:2031 (ret = xmlNewNsProp(ctxt->node, namespace, localname, NULL)), SAX2.c:2174 (xmlAddID(&ctxt->vctxt, ctxt->myDoc, dup, ret)), valid.c:2651 (ret->attr = attr) with ret->name = NULL at 2652 for the xml:id branch, xmlreader.c:305 (xmlTextReaderRemoveID(cur->parent->doc, cur)) under the intSubset/xmlIsID guard, xmlreader.c:275 (id->name = attr->name), xmlreader.c:310 (DICT_FREE(cur->name)), xmlreader.c:531 (xmlTextReaderFreeIDTable), xmlreader.c:242 (DICT_FREE(id->name)). tree.c:1878 is confirmed by the ASan allocation stack.

root_cause is faithful to patch.diff: the vulnerable xmlTextReaderRemoveID has `id->name = attr->name;` at line 275 with `id->attr = NULL;` immediately following and NO clearing of attr->name; commit 26828cb3 inserts exactly `attr->name = NULL;` between them (at line 276). This is precisely the missing ownership-clear the GT identifies as root cause. The GT frames the mechanism as dual ownership of the same 'id' name string that leads to two frees (xmlreader.c:310 then xmlreader.c:242), not as 'the crash disappears'.

source is project SAX parser code (xmlSAX2AttributeNs materializing the xml:id attribute), not a fuzz-harness wrapper. reachability_checkpoints.parser_admitted (xmlTextReaderStartElementNs:738) is a distinct, strictly-earlier format-acceptance point, consistent with the ASan allocation stack frame 4.

tainted_value_origin (tree.c:1878, cur->name = xmlStrdup(name)) correctly identifies the 3-byte 'id' name allocation [0x6020000001d0,0x6020000001d3) that is the double-freed object; matches sanitizer_trace.txt allocation site and region_size=3.

Bug-class coverage is complete for a double-free: alloc site (step 2, tree.c:1878), root-cause aliasing without clear (step 7, xmlreader.c:275), first free (step 8, xmlreader.c:310) and second free / sink (step 10, xmlreader.c:242) are all represented and consistent with the ASan free_stack and crash_stack. The control precondition (DOCTYPE internal subset + xmlIsID for xml:id at xmlreader.c:301-305) is captured in step 6's notes.

Minor (non-blocking, not a correctness defect): two fine_trace depends_on `via` labels annotate with the aliasing/fix statement rather than the literal return-to-caller control edge -- step 7 depends_on {on:6,type:control,via:'attr->name = NULL'} and step 8 depends_on {on:7,type:control,via:'id->name = attr->name'}. Step ordering, roles, and data dependencies are correct; no fix required.
